title: Study on Outcomes of Proximal Humerus Fractures
official: Review of Proximal Humerus Fracture Outcomes
summary: Patients undergoing either operative or non-operative treatment of proximal humerus fractures will be studied with the goal of understanding which treatment modality provides optimal post-injury outcomes.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* individuals 65 years of age or older with proximal humerus fractures
